bug_semantics: Mithril STM-certifies a digest of completed Cardano immutable files, but the snapshot artifact used for fast bootstrap also contained unsigned ancillary files: ledger-state snapshots and the still-growing last immutable trio. mithril-client restored that mixed archive into the Cardano node db without an authenticity check on the ancillary files. Cardano node startup only does structural/lightweight ledger checks, so a tampered ledger from a malicious or compromised aggregator can be loaded and can enable long-range attacks that honest nodes may not correct even if they sync from genesis (CWE-345).
flaw_origin: On 2022-04-19 the aggregator first hashed only files under immutable/ while tar.append_dir_all packaged the entire Cardano DB, including ledger/volatile. The same day the client first implemented unarchive_snapshot (Archive::unpack of that mixed tarball into db/) with no verification of the unsigned files (issue #102: restore without certificate verification). On 2022-05-10 ImmutableFile::list_in_dir began skip(3) of the last immutable trio while still archiving the whole DB. Later certificate-chain checks of the immutable digest and the 2023 mithril-client library refactor preserved restore of unsigned ancillary files until the 2517 IOG-key ancillary manifest.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: GHSA-qv97-5qr8-2266 is a real, non-withdrawn GitHub-reviewed advisory with no CVE assignment. The mechanism is CWE-345 on Cardano DB snapshots: STM signs only completed immutables, while fast-bootstrap artifacts still shipped unsigned ledger state and the last immutable trio; mithril-client restored those files and Cardano node would not systematically reject a tampered ledger. The smallest first-write of the client-side consumption path (the GHSA package) is 07b38289ad8ef04ac5e9d8799d5f254b28e1e26f, which added Archive::unpack of the mixed snapshot into db/. Immediate parent bb8764aced9970b0e3fbbe71830374de921ad25e only downloads the archive and leaves restore_snapshot as a no-op; unarchive_snapshot is absent there. That commit is a single-parent first-write, not a move/refactor/squash. Complementary producer pairing (hash immutables, archive whole db) is 0363caa9356585d46fd03badc24443d2918aaa96; last-immutable skip(3) while still archiving everything is 3b60e9a3eb01d40164af547469eb917e37f3c416 — later expansions of the same unsigned-ancillary set, not the BIC. Later library/certificate-chain work refactored restore but kept unsigned ancillary restoration until 2517. Fix is two-sided: aggregator PR #2394 signs an ancillary manifest with an IOG key; client PR #2414 verifies it (direct 84ae7cadcc29b8fd2142754e78f50a627cd9e7d0) and otherwise omits ancillary files. BIC precedes 2513.0; the client verify merge is in 2517.0/2517.1 and not in 2513.0. AI is judged only on the BIC commit object: human IOHK author/committer, no AI/co-author/bot markers, so NOT_AI.
